argv: a time capsule and a plaque from the places archive
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone with switches saved before this update, open "What I'm into", then walk (Explore on) past a time capsule and a plaque from the places archive. **Expect:** Plaques and markers, Small memorials, Milestones and old stones and Wayside shrines and crosses sit indented under their kinds and are off; Time capsules and Little libraries are on; the time capsule is a "?" named "A time capsule" within 60 m and the plaque is not drawn until its row is switched on; an area's dots change at once when the row is switched (SP2, SP7, SP8, SP11, SP13).

- **Category headings in "What I'm into"** (the UI review's U4): eighteen rows with no group names, so a card's "History" cannot be matched to a block of rows; the five categories as headers would answer it, a change to the whole list rather than to this slice.

- **The drawer's grabber over a row** (the UI review's U6, before this slice): in the walk's drawer the grabber is drawn over the half-clipped first row; it wants its own strip above the scrolling list.

| Small places (OpenStreetMap locates a pinned table of small places, the kind Pikmin Bloom's postcards reach: time capsules and little libraries on, plaques and markers, small memorials, milestones and old stones, wayside shrines off by default, each a switch under its kind; unnamed ones named by type; the bars weigh them by the size of the stop only when switched on; never a park's signal, never a route's lean, never drowning the lows; SP1-SP22, decision 0182; the data side is chronicles-data's SL1-SL11) | built 2026-11-16, test-first (22 of 22): unit tests, typecheck, lint, docs and vision checks; e2e `small-places` (new), `marks`, `curiosities` and the journeys covering its files; cold find and UI review triaged (`small-places ui 1-3`); not deployed; chronicles-data's branch not merged; native unverified | `claude/epic-darwin-m94owv` (both repos) | `specs/small-places/spec.md` (repo first) | no |
